answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> World Religions Question ID: 41598 Country: AF Title: What do you says about somebody who prayed first like imam abu hanifa madhab and then prays like im schafi or like the salafis ? Question: Is somebody who changes his madhhab who was told by his father bad? Answer ID: 41598 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 917/911/N=1433) It is lawful to change the maslak in some cases and in some cases unlawful which is based upon the reason of changing. Hence in the question mentioned above ask the person why he wants to change his maslak, then we shall write the Shariah ruling about it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
